# ForgeLabs App Ad Studio

> A web app that turns an app's screenshots and screen recordings into ready-to-test vertical video ads for Reels, TikTok and Shorts. Free during the beta.

The founder names the app, says what it does in one line, uploads its real screens (or pastes an App Store or Google Play link, which fills these in) and picks hooks. The Studio checks every hook for claims ad platforms reject, then renders a pack: three to five 1080x1920 videos that share one body (so a test compares only the hooks), with an AI voiceover, word-by-word captions, 4:5 and 9:16 images, .srt caption files, ad copy and a test plan. It doesn't run ads or connect to ad accounts.

- [Home page](https://forgelaboratory.net/): what the Studio does, example ads, pricing and FAQ
- [How to make video ads for your app](https://forgelaboratory.net/guide/app-video-ads/): the core method, from hook to test
- [App ad hook examples](https://forgelaboratory.net/hooks/): eight hook types with patterns, real hooks and their Meta results, and lines that fail
- [App video ad examples](https://forgelaboratory.net/examples/): three real ads with scripts, structure and results
- [FAQ](https://forgelaboratory.net/faq/): what the Studio does, the pack, AI hooks and voices, ad approval, pricing and data
- [Case study: StockMatcherAI](https://forgelaboratory.net/case-studies/stockmatcherai/): real Meta results from ads made with the engine
- [Sign up](https://forgelaboratory.net/app/?new=1)
